title: The Confession of the Fens Anew
author: Ulyana Vane
blurb: Lena Zhou, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
